meta.name: free talk 话题库
meta.source: 英文问句取自 GitHub 1599570912/IELTS-Speaking-AI（MIT License）题库，实测 62 条剔除 2 条考官身份核验题后为 60 条；中文翻译、追问、参考词汇、表达支架、参考回答为本项目自撰
meta.licenseNote: MIT 条款要求保留原作者版权声明，见文末 source 字段及 tools/freetalk/README.md

topics.q: Where are you from?
topics.zh: 你来自哪里？
follow: Do you work or study?
What do you do for work/study?
Do you like your job/studies? Why?
topics.tips: 用 I come from… / I grew up in… 开头，再补一句这个地方的特点（食物、天气、节奏）。
topics.sample: Nice to meet you. I'm originally from China — I was born in a city near Shanghai [L1.1]. Actually, I'm from the south, but my family moved here eight years ago, when I was in high school [L1.1]. I came here after I graduated from college [L2.1].

topics.q: Do you work or study?
topics.zh: 你在工作还是上学？
follow: What do you do for work/study?
Do you like your job/studies? Why?
Where are you from?
topics.tips: 直接说现状，再加一句专业或年级：I am a … major in my … year.
topics.sample: I'm still a student [L8.2]. I'm in my third year now, and I'm not sure what I want to do with my life, to be honest [L18.1]. Actually, I majored in English Literature [L20.2], but I haven't made up my mind about the future yet [L14.2].
src: I can't decide what I want to do with my life

topics.q: What do you do for work/study?
topics.zh: 你的工作/学业具体是做什么的？
follow: Do you work or study?
Do you like your job/studies? Why?
Where are you from?
topics.tips: 别只报专业名，说一件具体的日常事（做实验、写代码、赶报告），内容才立得住。
topics.sample: Most of my time goes to my coursework. I work with computers a lot — sort of like being in charge of the class project [L1.2]. It's not easy, and I'm not very good at it yet [L1.1], but I'm getting better. The same routine every day can get boring [L9.2], but it's worth it.

topics.q: Do you like your job/studies? Why?
topics.zh: 你喜欢自己的工作/学业吗？为什么？
follow: What do you do for work/study?
Do you work or study?
Where are you from?
topics.tips: 喜欢就说喜欢什么，不喜欢就说哪一点烦，但结尾要转回积极：But overall…。
topics.sample: Mostly, yes. I like the part where I get to build something real. But I'm really sick of sitting in front of a computer all day [L9.2]. I think I need to try something totally different [L9.2] — I'd love something that would involve travel [L8.1]. Still, at this point in my life, I'm learning a lot [L14.2].
src: sick of sitting in front of a computer
at this point in my life

topics.q: Do you have a large family?
topics.zh: 你家里人多吗？
follow: How much time do you spend with your family?
What do you like to do together as a family?
Do you prefer spending time with family or friends?
topics.tips: 先答大不大，再补人数构成：There are … of us / I am an only child.
topics.sample: Not really. It's just my parents and me at home — I don't have any relatives here [L2.1]. In China, on holidays or the weekend, we visit relatives [L2.1], so our big family gets together then. I have a lot of friends, but that's not the same thing [L2.1].
src: I don't have any relatives here

topics.q: How much time do you spend with your family?
topics.zh: 你花多少时间和家人在一起？
follow: What do you like to do together as a family?
Do you have a large family?
Do you prefer spending time with family or friends?
topics.tips: 用频率副词（most evenings / once a week / during holidays）把时间说具体。
topics.sample: On weekdays, not much — I'm busy and so are my parents. But on the weekend we do things together. I really miss my mother's cooking [L2.1], so I try to be home for dinner. I guess that's when we really talk.
src: I really miss my mother's cooking

topics.q: What do you like to do together as a family?
topics.zh: 你们一家喜欢一起做什么？
follow: How much time do you spend with your family?
Do you have a large family?
How often do you meet your friends?
topics.tips: 挑一件具体的事讲细节（谁做什么、什么时候），比罗列三个活动强。
topics.sample: We cook together, mostly. My mom makes great soup [L2.1], and I'm in charge of the rest [L1.2]. I'm not very good at it [L1.1], but we always have a great time [L3.1]. On holidays and stuff, the whole family gets together [L3.2].
src: I'm not very good at it
we always had a great time

topics.q: Do you prefer spending time with family or friends?
topics.zh: 你更喜欢和家人还是朋友待在一起？
follow: How often do you meet your friends?
What do you usually do with your friends?
How much time do you spend with your family?
topics.tips: 用 It depends on … 分情况回答，能自然把两面都说出来。
topics.sample: It depends. With my family I can be completely myself — they never make me feel judged. But I know what you mean about friends [L8.1]; with them I talk about things my parents wouldn't get. I'd love to say both, but if I had to choose, family on quiet days, friends on loud ones.

topics.q: How often do you meet your friends?
topics.zh: 你多久见一次朋友？
follow: What do you usually do with your friends?
Do you prefer spending time with family or friends?
How much time do you spend with your family?
topics.tips: 给频率 + 原因（课表冲突、住得远），再补一句线上联系也算。
topics.sample: Probably once or twice a week. We used to meet more when we were students [L3.1], but now everybody's busy. We still text a lot. I hope we can get together more often [L22.2] — it's just a matter of time.

topics.q: What do you usually do with your friends?
topics.zh: 你和朋友通常一起做什么？
follow: How often do you meet your friends?
Do you prefer spending time with family or friends?
What do you like to do in your free time?
topics.tips: 讲一次具体的经历，用 Last time we… 开头，回答立刻有画面。
topics.sample: Mostly ordinary things — we walk around, grab a bite, talk about nothing. Sometimes we just play video games [L12.1]. You know, I really enjoy spending time with them [L3.2]. We always have a great time, even when we're doing nothing [L3.1].
src: we always had a great time

topics.q: What do you like to do in your free time?
topics.zh: 你空闲时喜欢做什么？
follow: Do you have any hobbies?
When did you start this hobby?
Is it an expensive hobby?
topics.tips: 给一个主活动 + 一个替补（when I am too tired…），答案更立体。
topics.sample: I read a lot, and I go for long walks. When I was a kid, I used to collect shells [L3.1], and walking along the beach is still my favourite thing. I also like to catch up on my reading [L10.1] when I have a free weekend.

topics.q: Do you have any hobbies?
topics.zh: 你有什么爱好吗？
follow: When did you start this hobby?
Is it an expensive hobby?
What do you like to do in your free time?
topics.tips: 说清「认真到什么程度」：I am not serious about it / I take it fairly seriously.
topics.sample: I do, though I'm not serious about any of them. I used to collect shells when I was a kid [L3.1] — I had a great shell collection [L3.1]. These days I read and take photos. Nothing expensive, I'm not very good at most of it [L1.1], but I enjoy it.

topics.q: When did you start this hobby?
topics.zh: 你什么时候开始这个爱好的？
follow: Is it an expensive hobby?
Do you have any hobbies?
What do you like to do in your free time?
topics.tips: 用 I picked it up … ago / I have been doing it on and off since … 表达断续坚持。
topics.sample: I started when I was in high school. When I was a kid, we used to spend two weeks at the beach every summer [L3.1], and that's where the habit came from. I've kept it on and off since then. It takes a bit of getting used to at first [L22.2], but now it's part of me.
src: When I was a kid, we used to spend …
It takes a bit of getting used to

topics.q: Is it an expensive hobby?
topics.zh: 这个爱好花钱多吗？
follow: When did you start this hobby?
Do you have any hobbies?
What hobbies are popular in your country?
topics.tips: 先给结论 It can be / Not really，再举一个价格细节支撑，比空说贵不贵有力。
topics.sample: Not really. My camera is second-hand, and I've used the same one for years. The expensive version exists, of course — it costs three or four times as much [L5.1] — but I don't need it. I'd rather keep it simple.
src: it costs three or four times as much

topics.q: What hobbies are popular in your country?
topics.zh: 你们国家什么爱好比较流行？
follow: What do you like to do in your free time?
Do you have any hobbies?
Do you think hobbies should be shared with other people?
topics.tips: 用 … has really taken off recently 描述流行趋势，别只列清单。
topics.sample: Short videos are everywhere now, and running has really taken off. Honestly, I think people are a bit too busy for hobbies these days — there's so much to see and do [L11.1] online that nobody slows down. I guess that's just how it is [L1.2].
src: There's so much to see and do

topics.q: Do you think hobbies should be shared with other people?
topics.zh: 你觉得爱好应该和别人一起做吗？
follow: What hobbies are popular in your country?
Do you have any hobbies?
What do you like to do in your free time?
topics.tips: 观点题用 I think it depends on the person 开头，再分两面说，最后落到自己。
topics.sample: I think it depends on the person. Some hobbies are better shared, because you get to meet people and make new friends [L9.3]. Others are private, and that's fine too. At first, I thought I should share mine [L22.2], but then I realized I like doing them alone [L22.2].
src: get to meet people and make new friends
At first, I thought … But then I realized …

topics.q: Do you use the internet very much?
topics.zh: 你上网多吗？
follow: What do you do on the internet?
When did you first start using the internet?
Do you think the internet is useful?
topics.tips: 给一个量化的说法（several hours a day / far too much），比 very much 更实。
topics.sample: Far too much, honestly. I'm really sick of sitting in front of a screen all day [L9.2], but I keep doing it. It's impossible to avoid [L4.1] — everything is online now. I know what you mean if you say the same [L8.1].
src: sick of sitting in front of a computer

topics.q: When did you first start using the internet?
topics.zh: 你最早是什么时候开始上网的？
follow: Do you use the internet very much?
What do you do on the internet?
How has technology changed the way people communicate?
topics.tips: 对比过去和现在的设备/速度，用 Back then… Now… 结构。
topics.sample: When I was a kid, I used to get up early and play outside [L3.1], not stare at a screen. I started using the internet in high school, on the family computer. Back then it was slow — but it's not the same thing at all now [L2.1].
src: Every day we used to get up early

topics.q: What do you do on the internet?
topics.zh: 你上网都做些什么？
follow: Do you use the internet very much?
Do you think the internet is useful?
What are the pros and cons of children using the internet?
topics.tips: 分两类说：有用的（查资料/学东西）+ 纯消遣的，显出自我觉察。
topics.sample: Two kinds of things. The useful kind: tutorials, news, things for my school work. The other kind is just scrolling. I'm not very good at controlling it [L1.1], to be honest. I keep meaning to use it less, but I guess that's easier said than done [L1.2].

topics.q: Do you think the internet is useful?
topics.zh: 你觉得互联网有用吗？
follow: What do you do on the internet?
What are the pros and cons of children using the internet?
How can we ensure technology is used responsibly?
topics.tips: 别一边倒。用 It is useful, but… 承认代价，观点更可信。
topics.sample: Yes, but it's double-edged. There's so much to see and do [L11.1], and that's wonderful. But there are also too many distractions [L4.1]. I think the biggest mistake people make is trying to do too much [L11.1] — online, just like in real life.
src: There's so much to see and do
the biggest mistake many people make is trying to do too much

topics.q: What are the pros and cons of children using the internet?
topics.zh: 孩子上网有哪些好处和坏处？
follow: Do you think the internet is useful?
What do you do on the internet?
How can we ensure technology is used responsibly?
topics.tips: 利弊题用 On the one hand… On the other hand…，最后给一条自己的建议收尾。
topics.sample: On the one hand, children can learn so much — there's so much to see and do [L11.1]. On the other hand, they can get lost in it. I think the biggest mistake parents make is not watching what kids do online [L11.1]. Another thing to remember is to set limits [L11.1] — otherwise it's impossible to keep up with them [L4.1].
src: There's so much to see and do

topics.q: Do you like music?
topics.zh: 你喜欢音乐吗？
follow: What kind of music do you like?
Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument?
Do you think it is important for children to learn a musical instrument?
topics.tips: 说清音乐在你生活里的角色（背景音 / 专注用 / 睡前），比 yes, very much 有内容。
topics.sample: I do, though I'm not a big music person. I mostly use it as background. You know, it's funny — I'm not very good at singing or anything [L1.1], but I love listening. I guess I sort of just enjoy the feeling [L1.2].

topics.q: What kind of music do you like?
topics.zh: 你喜欢什么类型的音乐？
follow: Do you like music?
Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument?
What kind of music do you like?
topics.tips: 给一主一次两种风格，并说「什么时候听哪种」，答案立刻具体。
topics.sample: Mostly quiet things — I like music I can think to. I'm not very good at explaining it [L1.1], but slow songs with guitar are my thing. I go through phases, though. I guess I just like whatever fits the mood [L1.2].

topics.q: Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument?
topics.zh: 你学过乐器吗？
follow: Which instrument would you prefer to study, the piano or the violin?
Do you think it is important for children to learn a musical instrument?
What kind of music do you like?
topics.tips: 学过又放弃是很真实的答案，用 I gave up because… 讲清原因即可。
topics.sample: I had piano lessons as a kid, but I gave up. I'm not very good at it [L1.1] and I never practised. I used to really enjoy it at first [L3.2], but then it became the same routine every day [L9.2], and I got sick of it [L9.2]. Sometimes I wish I had kept it up [L8.2].
src: I'm not very good at it

topics.q: Which instrument would you prefer to study, the piano or the violin?
topics.zh: 钢琴和小提琴，你更想学哪个？
follow: Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument?
Do you think it is important for children to learn a musical instrument?
Do you like music?
topics.tips: 二选一题要给出「为什么不是另一个」的理由，这是得分点。
topics.sample: The piano, definitely. It's more forgiving at the start — you get a nice sound right away. The violin sounds terrible for months. I'm not very good at being patient [L1.1], so I'd rather play something I can enjoy quickly. It's a deal for me [L1.2].

topics.q: Do you think it is important for children to learn a musical instrument?
topics.zh: 你觉得孩子学乐器重要吗？
follow: Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument?
What role should technology play in education?
How important is it for students to learn practical skills?
topics.tips: 观点题先让步 Admittedly…，再转折 But I think…,显得思考过两面。
topics.sample: I think it depends on the child. Some kids love it, and some are forced into it and end up sick of it [L9.2]. I'd say let them try — but don't be afraid to let them stop [L11.1] if it's not for them. It's best to let them decide [L11.1].

topics.q: Do you like sport?
topics.zh: 你喜欢运动吗？
follow: What sports do you play?
What is the most popular sport in your country?
What are the benefits of playing sport?
topics.tips: 区分「看」和「做」：I like watching… more than playing…，这是很自然的展开。
topics.sample: I like watching it more than playing it. When I was a kid, I used to run around all day [L3.1], but now I'm not very good at keeping it up [L1.1]. I do swim when I can. I guess I'm more of a fan [L1.2].

topics.q: What sports do you play?
topics.zh: 你做什么运动？
follow: Do you like sport?
What are the benefits of playing sport?
Do you think children should play sport?
topics.tips: 说频率和水平（twice a week / badly but happily），避免空泛。
topics.sample: I swim, and I rollerblade sometimes [L1.1]. Where did I learn to rollerblade? [L1.1] In the park near my house. This is only my second time at some of these [L1.1], so I'm not very good at them [L1.1], but I enjoy it.
src: Where did you learn to rollerblade?
This is only my second time

topics.q: What is the most popular sport in your country?
topics.zh: 你们国家最流行的运动是什么？
follow: What is your favorite sport to watch on TV?
Do you like sport?
What sports do you play?
topics.tips: 不只报名字，说它流行在哪（ grassroots 参与 / 电视转播 / 民族情绪）。
topics.sample: Table tennis, without question. It's played everywhere, from school yards to the national team. Honestly, there are too many people playing it to count [L4.1]. I guess it's cheap and easy, and that's why it's everywhere [L1.2].

topics.q: What is your favorite sport to watch on TV?
topics.zh: 你最喜欢在电视上看什么运动？
follow: Do you like sport?
What is the most popular sport in your country?
What sports do you play?
topics.tips: 讲一个看的理由（节奏、悬念、解说），比报项目名更有话。
topics.sample: I mostly watch swimming, because the races are fast and exciting. I can't stop watching once a big race gets started [L21.3]. I also like watching basketball. I guess I just enjoy the tension [L1.2].
src: I couldn't stop … once I got started

topics.q: Do you think children should play sport?
topics.zh: 你觉得孩子应该参加体育运动吗？
follow: What are the benefits of playing sport?
Do you like sport?
How important is it for students to learn practical skills?
topics.tips: 观点题用 I think so, as long as… 加条件，观点更严密。
topics.sample: I think so, as long as it stays fun. Sport teaches kids to handle losing, which is hard to learn anywhere else. But too much pressure turns them off. I wish more schools understood that [L8.2] — it's the same thing with any activity [L2.1].

topics.q: What are the benefits of playing sport?
topics.zh: 运动有什么好处？
follow: Do you think children should play sport?
What sports do you play?
Do you like sport?
topics.tips: 身体 + 心理各说一条，再落到自己的体验，最有说服力。
topics.sample: The obvious one is health, but for me it's more about the head. After I move, my mood is completely different. When I was a kid I used to be outside all day [L3.1], and I really enjoyed it [L3.2]. I guess our bodies remember that [L1.2].

topics.q: Describe a person you admire.
topics.zh: 描述一个你敬佩的人。
bullets: How you know about this person
And explain why you admire this person
follow: What qualities make a person admirable?
Do you think children need role models?
What influence can famous people have on society?
topics.tips: 四个要点逐个覆盖，最后 why 那条要多说两句——那是考官真正等的部分。
topics.sample: The person I admire most is my aunt. I've known her my whole life, so I've watched how she lives. She runs a small restaurant, and she's in charge of everything [L1.2] — the cooking, the money, the people. What I really admire is that she never seems to lighten up [L14.1], in a good way: she's serious about her work but warm to everyone. It's hard to get a smile out of her when she's busy [L14.1], but when she does smile, the whole room changes. She's always giving people presents and help [L14.1], and I wish there were more people like her in this world [L14.1]. I guess that's why I admire her [L1.2] — she made a hard life look graceful.
src: get a smile out of her
I wish there were more people like her

topics.q: Describe a memorable journey you have taken.
topics.zh: 描述一次难忘的旅行。
bullets: And explain why this journey was memorable
follow: What are the benefits of traveling?
How has traveling changed over the years?
Do you think space travel will be common in the future?
topics.tips: 「为什么难忘」要落在具体的一件事上（一次意外、一个人），不要只说风景很美。
topics.sample: Two summers ago I took a long train ride to a mountain town with two friends. We went because it was cheap, and the journey was something else. You know, I'm so excited just thinking about it [L10.1]. The scenery was incredible — it was like nothing I'd seen, and I learned so much about the place just watching it go by [L21.4]. What made it unforgettable was a small accident: we missed our stop and had to spend the night in a tiny station. At first, I thought we were in trouble [L22.2], but then I realized it was the best part of the trip [L22.2]. We talked until sunrise, and every time I think of that night I smile [L3.2]. That's what I remember most about the whole journey [L3.2].
src: At first, I thought … But then I realized …

topics.q: Describe a skill you learned recently.
topics.zh: 描述你最近学会的一项技能。
bullets: How long it took you to learn
And explain how this skill has helped you
follow: What skills are most important in today's world?
How do people usually learn new skills?
Should schools teach more practical skills?
topics.tips: 讲学习过程中的一个挫败点 + 一个突破点，这是 Part 2 最有内容的结构。
topics.sample: Recently I learned to rollerblade [L1.1]. I wanted to learn because I saw people doing it in the park near my house, and it looked like fun. I got a friend to give me some lessons [L1.1] — at first this was only my second time [L1.1], so I fell a lot. It took me about a month to feel steady. I'm not very good at it yet [L1.1], but I'm much better than when I started. The funny thing is how it's helped me: I'm less afraid of looking silly now, because I spent a month falling in public. And it's something I'll find useful later in life [L9.4], even if it's just a way to get around.
src: This is only my second time
I'm not very good at it
something you'll find useful later in life

topics.q: Describe a place you would like to visit.
topics.zh: 描述一个你想去的地方。
bullets: How you know about this place
And explain why you want to visit this place
follow: Why do people like to travel to different places?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of tourism?
How do you think tourism will change in the future?
topics.tips: 「你怎么知道这地方的」很容易被忽略，别漏——它让故事有来源。
topics.sample: I'd love to visit the Statue of Liberty in New York [L19.2]. I first learned about it in a school book — the statue was given to the United States by the people of France [L19.2], and it's a major tourist attraction, with about 2 million people from all over the world visiting every year [L19.1]. When I go, I'd climb the stairs all the way up to the crown [L19.2] — it's just 142 steps [L19.2]. I'd also just walk around the city, because there's so much to see and do [L11.1]. I want to go there and see it for myself [L21.4], not just in pictures.
src: given to the United States by the people of France
a major tourist attraction … from all over the world
climb the stairs … up to the crown
There's so much to see and do

topics.q: What are the advantages of online learning?
topics.zh: 在线学习有哪些优势？
follow: Do you think traditional teaching methods are still effective?
What role should technology play in education?
How has education changed in recent years?
topics.tips: Part 3 要给「分析型」答案：先答，再说条件或反例，别停在描述。
topics.sample: The main advantage is flexibility — you can learn when it suits you. I'd love something like that [L8.1], because not everyone has the same routine [L9.2]. But I think there's a real difficulty: studying alone is hard, and it's not the same thing as being in a room with a teacher [L2.1]. I guess the best version mixes both [L1.2].

topics.q: How has education changed in recent years?
topics.zh: 近年来教育发生了怎样的变化？
follow: What role should technology play in education?
Do you think traditional teaching methods are still effective?
What are the advantages of online learning?
topics.tips: 讲「从什么变成什么」，用 There has been a shift from… to… 结构。
topics.sample: There has been a real change, that's for sure [L4.1]. When I was a kid, we used to learn mostly from books [L3.1]. Now there's so much to see and do online [L11.1], and classrooms have changed with it. I guess one of the biggest differences is that information is everywhere now [L2.1]. But more access isn't automatically the same thing as better learning [L2.1].
src: When I was a kid, we used to …
There's so much to see and do
one of the biggest … is that …

topics.q: Do you think traditional teaching methods are still effective?
topics.zh: 你觉得传统教学方法还有效吗？
follow: What role should technology play in education?
What are the advantages of online learning?
How has education changed in recent years?
topics.tips: 不要一刀切。说清「在什么条件下有效」，这是 Part 3 的高分思维。
topics.sample: I wouldn't call them outdated. A clear explanation from a good teacher is hard to beat — I know, because I had some great ones. But I also think you can't just do the same routine every day [L9.2] and expect attention. The best mix uses both. I guess that's where we're heading [L1.2].

topics.q: What role should technology play in education?
topics.zh: 技术在教育中应扮演什么角色？
follow: Do you think traditional teaching methods are still effective?
What are the advantages of online learning?
What are the potential risks of our increasing dependence on technology?
topics.tips: 用 should 类题目给立场 + 边界：It should be…, but it must not become…。
topics.sample: It should be a tool, not a replacement. Used well, it frees teachers to do the part only people can do. Used badly, it's just another screen. I think the biggest mistake is giving kids screens and thinking that's teaching [L11.1]. Another thing to remember is that technology breaks, and people don't [L11.1].

topics.q: How important is it for students to learn practical skills?
topics.zh: 学生学习实用技能有多重要？
follow: Should schools teach more practical skills?
What skills are most important in today's world?
How has education changed in recent years?
topics.tips: 承认 trade-off（时间有限）再表态，观点更成熟。
topics.sample: Important, but there's a trade-off, because time is limited. Practical skills are something you'll find useful later in life [L9.4], that's for sure [L4.1]. But I wouldn't give up the basics for them. I think the best schools give you both. I guess it's about balance [L1.2].
src: something you'll find useful later in life

topics.q: What are the benefits of studying abroad?
topics.zh: 出国留学有什么好处？
follow: How has education changed in recent years?
What are the main challenges facing young people today?
How important is it to preserve cultural traditions?
topics.tips: 说好处的同时提一句代价（成本/不公平），显示你能看两面。
topics.sample: The biggest benefit is that you change. I came here after I graduated [L2.1], so I know this firsthand. Being an immigrant is hard — one of the biggest difficulties is that I don't have any relatives here [L2.1], and I miss my mother's cooking [L2.1]. But I learned to stand on my own feet, and that's not something a classroom gives you. It takes a bit of getting used to [L22.2], but it's worth it.
src: I came here after I graduated
one of the biggest difficulties is that I don't have any relatives here
I really miss my mother's cooking
It takes a bit of getting used to

topics.q: What are the main environmental problems in your country?
topics.zh: 你们国家主要的环境问题是什么？
follow: How can individuals help protect the environment?
Do you think governments are doing enough to tackle climate change?
What role should businesses play in environmental protection?
topics.tips: 列 2 个问题并各说一句成因或影响，不要只报名词。
topics.sample: The most visible one used to be traffic — there are too many cars and there isn't enough parking [L4.1]. It's impossible to find a parking space downtown [L4.1]. Air quality has got better, but there are still problems. I guess the biggest issue is that we make more waste than we can handle [L2.1].
src: there are too many cars … not enough parking
It's impossible to find a parking space
one of the biggest … is that …

topics.q: How can individuals help protect the environment?
topics.zh: 个人可以如何保护环境？
follow: Is it realistic to expect people to change their lifestyle to help the environment?
What role should businesses play in environmental protection?
What are the main environmental problems in your country?
topics.tips: 先给具体做法，再指出个人力量的边界，这是成熟答案的标志。
topics.sample: The everyday things still matter. We need more people to take the bus or subway [L4.1], and fewer to drive. There should be more public transportation in general [L4.2]. Personally, I try to waste less food — my mom always said not to throw things out carelessly [L3.1]. But I also think the biggest changes have to come from governments, not just individuals [L11.1].
src: There should be more public transportation in general

topics.q: Do you think governments are doing enough to tackle climate change?
topics.zh: 你认为政府在应对气候变化上做得够吗？
follow: What role should businesses play in environmental protection?
How can individuals help protect the environment?
How might cities change in the future to be more environmentally friendly?
topics.tips: 区分「承诺」和「执行」，用 There is a gap between… and…。
topics.sample: Honestly, I don't think enough, not yet. There's a gap between what they say and what they do, that's for sure [L4.1]. They should ban the worst polluters [L4.1], and they need to put more money into public transport [L4.1]. I guess it's easier to promise than to act [L1.2].
src: they need to put more … on the road

topics.q: What role should businesses play in environmental protection?
topics.zh: 企业在环保中应承担什么角色？
follow: Do you think governments are doing enough to tackle climate change?
How can individuals help protect the environment?
What are the main environmental problems in your country?
topics.tips: 提到 greenwashing（漂绿）这类概念能显出你有实质观点。
topics.sample: A large one, because companies produce most of the waste. I think they should be made to clean up their own mess [L4.1]. Another thing to remember is that companies follow the money [L11.1], so rules matter more than promises. It's a deal only if it's enforced [L1.2].

topics.q: How might cities change in the future to be more environmentally friendly?
topics.zh: 未来城市会如何变得更环保？
follow: Is it realistic to expect people to change their lifestyle to help the environment?
How might technology change education in the future?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in a big city?
topics.tips: 给 2~3 个具体方向（密度/公交/改造），避免空说 will be greener。
topics.sample: I think the biggest change will be in transport. Singapore is a great example — quite a number of things have been done there to help solve traffic problems [L5.1]. They built an excellent public transportation system, and their subway is one of the best in the world [L5.1]. Cities should ban private cars downtown [L4.1] and build more lines. There should be more public transportation in general [L4.2]. That's how cities get cleaner without making everyone change their whole life.
src: quite a number of things have been done
an excellent public transportation system … one of the best in the world
There should be more public transportation in general

topics.q: Is it realistic to expect people to change their lifestyle to help the environment?
topics.zh: 期待人们为环保改变生活方式现实吗？
follow: How can individuals help protect the environment?
What role should businesses play in environmental protection?
How might cities change in the future to be more environmentally friendly?
topics.tips: 关键论点：让环保成为「默认选项」而非道德选择——这是很强的 Part 3 观点。
topics.sample: Only partly. Most people will accept small changes, but not big sacrifices forever. I think it's more realistic to change the system than to change every person. I guess the truth is people follow the easiest path [L1.2]. So the answer is to make the easy path the clean one.

topics.q: How has technology changed the way people communicate?
topics.zh: 科技如何改变了人们的沟通方式？
follow: What are the advantages and disadvantages of social media?
What are the potential risks of our increasing dependence on technology?
How has family life changed in recent decades?
topics.tips: 对比 breadth 与 depth（广度 vs 深度）是这类题的经典高分框架。
topics.sample: It's made everything instant. You can reach anyone, anywhere. But I've noticed something: the way people talk online isn't the same thing as talking face to face [L2.1]. There are some things I find a bit unusual [L22.2], like how easy it is to misunderstand tone. At first, I thought it was just me [L22.2], but then I realized everyone feels it [L22.2]. It takes a bit of getting used to [L22.2].
src: some things I find a bit unusual
At first, I thought … But then I realized …
It takes a bit of getting used to

topics.q: What are the advantages and disadvantages of social media?
topics.zh: 社交媒体的利弊是什么？
follow: How has technology changed the way people communicate?
What are the potential risks of our increasing dependence on technology?
How can we ensure technology is used responsibly?
topics.tips: 两边各给一条，并指出同一个机制如何同时产生利弊（例如连接 vs 比较）。
topics.sample: The advantage is connection — you can meet people and make new friends [L9.3] from anywhere. But the downside is real too. I'm sick of hearing the same arguments online [L21.1], and it's impossible to have a quiet moment [L4.1]. I think the biggest problem is that people compare their real lives to everyone's highlights [L11.1].
src: meet people and make new friends

topics.q: Do you think artificial intelligence will replace human workers?
topics.zh: 你认为人工智能会取代人类劳动者吗？
follow: How can we ensure technology is used responsibly?
What are the potential risks of our increasing dependence on technology?
What skills are most important in today's world?
topics.tips: 区分「任务」和「整个职业」是这题的关键区分点，说出来就显得专业。
topics.sample: I think it will change jobs more than replace them, at least for a while. I could never do some of the things machines do [L18.1], that's for sure [L4.1]. But there's a part of most jobs that's about people, and that's not the same thing as computing [L2.1]. I guess we'll have to learn to work with it [L1.2].

topics.q: How might technology change education in the future?
topics.zh: 未来技术会如何改变教育？
follow: What role should technology play in education?
What are the advantages of online learning?
Do you think artificial intelligence will replace human workers?
topics.tips: 给一个具体设想 + 一个你担心的点，答案就有观点而不只是预测。
topics.sample: I think it will make learning more personal. Software can adapt to each student's mistakes, which a single teacher can't do for thirty kids. But I also worry it becomes the same routine every day [L9.2], just on a screen. I guess the best use keeps the human part [L1.2].

topics.q: What are the potential risks of our increasing dependence on technology?
topics.zh: 我们越来越依赖技术，有哪些潜在风险？
follow: How can we ensure technology is used responsibly?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of social media?
Do you think artificial intelligence will replace human workers?
topics.tips: 举一个具体风险场景（断网、技能退化），比泛泛说 dangerous 有力。
topics.sample: Two things worry me. First, we depend on systems that can fail, and when they do, it's impossible to do anything [L4.1]. Second, we stop practising basic skills — I used to remember phone numbers [L3.1], and now I can't. I guess the danger is that we forget how to manage without it [L1.2].

topics.q: How can we ensure technology is used responsibly?
topics.zh: 如何确保技术被负责任地使用？
follow: What are the potential risks of our increasing dependence on technology?
Do you think artificial intelligence will replace human workers?
What role should governments play in people's lives?
topics.tips: 给 2 条可操作措施（透明度/问责），再加一条教育层面的，结构完整。
topics.sample: I think it comes down to two things. First, rules — companies should be made to explain what their systems do [L4.1]. Second, education. People need to understand enough not to be fooled. Another thing to remember is that no system is neutral [L11.1]. I guess the answer is to keep asking questions [L1.2].

topics.q: How has family life changed in recent decades?
topics.zh: 近几十年家庭生活发生了什么变化？
follow: What are the main challenges facing young people today?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in a big city?
How important is it to preserve cultural traditions?
topics.tips: 用具体变化对照（规模、地理分散、双职工），别只说 it changed a lot。
topics.sample: Families are smaller and more spread out now. When I was a kid, we used to visit relatives on holidays and stuff [L3.2], and the whole family lived nearby. Now people move to different cities for work, so we don't have any relatives close by [L2.1]. I guess one of the biggest changes is that we see each other less [L2.1]. I really miss that [L2.1].
src: one of the biggest … is that …

topics.q: What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in a big city?
topics.zh: 住在大城市有什么利弊？
follow: How can communities be made stronger?
What are the main challenges facing young people today?
How has family life changed in recent decades?
topics.tips: 各给 2 条，并指出利弊同源（机会多 = 竞争和成本高）。
topics.sample: The advantage is that everything is close — work, food, people. But there are too many cars and there isn't enough parking [L4.1], and it's impossible to find a quiet moment [L4.1]. I'm sick of the noise sometimes [L9.2]. I guess it's worth it while you're young [L1.2], but not forever.
src: there are too many cars … not enough parking

topics.q: How important is it to preserve cultural traditions?
topics.zh: 保护文化传统有多重要？
follow: How can communities be made stronger?
How has family life changed in recent decades?
What role should governments play in people's lives?
topics.tips: 区分「保存」与「冻结」——传统要活着就得变，这是高分论点。
topics.sample: Very important, I think. Traditions give people a sense of where they come from. The Chinese Spring Festival is a good example — it's the grandest and the most important festival for Chinese people [L23.1]. Couplets are pasted at both sides of the gates [L23.1], and dumplings and the reunion dinner are indispensable at this time [L23.1]. But I also think traditions have to change a little to stay alive. It's not the same thing as freezing them in place [L2.1].
src: the grandest and the most important festival
Couplets are pasted at both sides of the gates
dumplings and the reunion dinner are indispensable

topics.q: What role should governments play in people's lives?
topics.zh: 政府应在民众生活中扮演什么角色？
follow: What role should businesses play in environmental protection?
How can communities be made stronger?
What are the main challenges facing young people today?
topics.tips: 这题要立场清晰：强在公共服务，弱在私人选择。给一条界线。
topics.sample: I think a government should do the things no single person can — roads, transport, safety. Singapore is a good example: quite a number of things have been done there to help solve traffic problems [L5.1], and that's exactly the kind of thing governments are for. But they shouldn't manage how people live day to day. I guess the line is where private life begins [L1.2].
src: quite a number of things have been done

topics.q: How can communities be made stronger?
topics.zh: 如何让社区更有凝聚力？
follow: What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in a big city?
How might cities change in the future to be more environmentally friendly?
How has family life changed in recent decades?
topics.tips: 给具体机制（共享空间 / 参与决策），避免口号式答案。
topics.sample: I think shared spaces help more than anything, because trust grows from small, repeated contact. Parks, markets, a good bus route — these bring people together without forcing it. When people meet regularly, they make new friends [L9.3]. I guess community is built slowly, by living side by side [L1.2].

topics.q: What are the main challenges facing young people today?
topics.zh: 当今年轻人面临的主要挑战是什么？
follow: What are the main environmental problems in your country?
How can communities be made stronger?
What skills are most important in today's world?
topics.tips: 经济 + 心理两条线都说，并指出它们的关联，答案更有深度。
topics.sample: I think the biggest challenge is uncertainty. The job market keeps changing, and it's impossible to plan too far ahead [L4.1]. On top of that, everyone compares themselves online. I know what you mean if you feel tired of it [L8.1]. I really need a change sometimes [L9.2], and I think a lot of young people feel the same. I guess the first step is to make up your mind about what you want [L14.2].
